Confirmed real: judge_loop.run is unwired (scripts/produce.py only imports its lower-level helpers -- run_judges/combine/compare/next_escalation -- never .run itself), and it has drifted from produce.py's path in two ways: JudgingStore.open_attempt() hashes the artifact BEFORE render_fn runs, and a failed render is written to the store but never added to the verdicts dict decide() sees, so three passing required judges can yield advance=True even when render_fn returned ok=false.
